integrity: Analytical block-factorization proof plus standalone integer/rational polynomial and small-graph checks; no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for finite connected cactus graphs with positive edge weights; no assertion on graphs with overlapping cycles, on higher-order association or on edge-negative association. Earlier implicit results could affect historical priority. Exact enumeration supports but does not replace the proof.
title: All-weight connectivity covariance on cactus graphs for random-cluster and forest laws
